implementation_summary: Replaced the private-member cast with server.auditWiring (one shared store, wiring.helperAccess only, wiring.isOwnerRequest). Registered auditContentRoutes and removed the NOT_IMPLEMENTED exclusion, so every AUDIT_API and AUDIT_AI_API entry has exactly one registered row with a beta policy. auditStoreRoutes gets a live-run isRunning from the shared AuditRuns (F-031). The rewrite-accept path goes through updateEditsOverlay (F-034). The registration test's fake server provides auditWiring.

tests_executed.name: audit route registration, route table, server audit wiring, route access server
tests_executed.command: CI=1 pnpm exec vitest run packages/runner/tests/audit-route-registration.test.ts packages/runner/tests/route-table.test.ts packages/runner/tests/server-audit-wiring.test.ts packages/runner/tests/route-access-server.test.ts

tests_proposed: Dispatch-level request for GET /api/audits as owner and as a Helper against a real RunnerServer
evidence: packages/runner/src/routes/index.ts: buildAuditRoutes uses server.auditWiring; auditContentRoutes registered; isRunning from runs; applyRewriteEdit via updateEditsOverlay
risks: isRunning only knows runs of the current process (intended for F-031)
Rewrite state on a cloud store is local under <dataDir>/audit-rewrites and not shared across instances
Env PAGESPEED_API_KEY counts as a saved key in the settings key port
PDF printer left at the export route default (Chromium per call)
handoff: allRoutes now holds one row per AUDIT_API and AUDIT_AI_API entry. Handlers are built lazily per runner by buildAuditRoutes(server) from server.auditWiring; the shared AuditRuns is held per server in a WeakMap in routes/index.ts.
